label: Patient-reported perspectives of a temporal relationship between autonomic dysfunction and mental health symptoms in a pediatric population.
summary: Autonomic dysfunction, characterized by orthostatic intolerance and presyncope, is understudied in youth. Mental health comorbidities are commonly reported and sometimes blamed for the onset of autonomic dysfunction; however, no studies have yet examined this relationship.
